sourceClass: first-party (NEXON America official MapleStory Maple Guides, GMS) read live, reconciled against lib/rules.ts LADDER/SOURCE and data/guide-graph.json
why: LADDER.secondary named an 'Absolab-tier' secondary that does not exist. The tell was that neither upper rung had an entry in the SOURCE table, so the advice rendered with an empty obtain-route string. This file asks the same question of every remaining rung and answers it per rung, with evidence.
readingNotes: Pages were read with a real browser (document body innerText). WebFetch returns only the SPA shell for nexon.com and answers 'no content' - do not trust a WebFetch 'page is empty' result on this domain as evidence of absence.

THE HEADLINE NEGATIVE FINDING, first-hand: the Boss Content page contains no drop table, no gear name and no boss-to-equipment mapping of any kind. It names 26 Practice Mode bosses and nothing else. It explicitly defers loot to the in-game UI: 'You can also open the Maple Guide with hotkey [F1] and select the "Boss Content" tab to see recommendations for bosses appropriate to various level ranges, as well as what can be looted from those bosses.' This confirms the earlier sweep recorded in activities.json and means NO rung's obtain route is first-party sourceable from the web corpus. Every route below is third-party at best.

The Set Items page names exactly two sets in the whole page - 'Pinnacle Set' and 'Boss Accessory Set' - and publishes no membership for either, pointing at the item tooltip instead: 'its tooltip displays the bonuses granted upon equipping items from the same set, as well as all of the items that can be collected'.

Gollux is absent from the Boss Content page in every difficulty, confirmed by direct read. Its cadence cannot even be inferred from the Practice Mode roster the way Lotus/Damien/Lucid/Will/Verus Hilla/Darknell/Kalos can.
Nexon's Kalos difficulty ladder is Easy/Normal/Chaos/Extreme. There is no Hard Kalos. Any boss row inventing one is wrong.

pageTextAddressingTheReader.quote: You can directly move to the information you want by searching it with [Ctrl + F].
pageTextAddressingTheReader.appearsOn: all three pages read on this pass
pageTextAddressingTheReader.assessment: Benign reader-facing UI hint, not an instruction directed at an agent. Not acted on. No text on any page read attempted to direct the reader to take an action outside the game.

method: lib/ was compiled to CommonJS in a scratch dir and LADDER/SOURCE were read out of the compiled module, not eyeballed. advise() was then run per slot on exampleCharacter() with the slot emptied, and the rendered strings captured verbatim. Every 'rendersAs' string below is a real render, not a reconstruction.

shape.note: 28 of 66 rungs (24 of 39 distinct names) have no SOURCE row. The retracted secondary had two such rungs and that was enough to retract the slot.

reproducedDefect.what: The secondary-bug signature - an obtain route that renders as the empty string - is live on 13 slots today.
reproducedDefect.howReproduced: For each slot: exampleCharacter(), delete the item, advise(slot, ch), read the 'Empty - X goes here.' rec's w field.
verbatimRenders: ring1  t='Empty - Meister Ring goes here.'  w=' · Lv. 140'
pocket t='Empty - Pink Bean pocket goes here.'  w=' · Lv. 140'
weapon t='Empty - Fafnir / CRA goes here.'  w=' · Lv. 150'
face   t='Empty - Condensed Power Crystal goes here.'  w=' · Lv. 140'
emblem t='Empty - Gold Maple Leaf Emblem goes here.'  w=' · Lv. 100'
alsoOnUpperRungs: top    t='Next tier: Arcane Umbra overall (Lv. 200).'  w=' - a Transfer Hammer only reaches Lv. 160 from Lv. 150, short of Arcane Umbra overall at Lv. 200, so do not over-cube what you will replace.'
belt   t='Next tier: Dreamy Belt (Lv. 160).'  w=' - a Transfer Hammer reaches Lv. 160 from Lv. 150, ...'
heart  t='Next tier: Black Heart (Lv. 150).'  w=' - a Transfer Hammer only reaches Lv. 130 from Lv. 120, ...'
pocket t='Next tier: Stone of Eternal Life (Lv. 160).'  w=' - a Transfer Hammer reaches Lv. 160 from Lv. 150, ...'
badge  t='Next tier: Genesis Badge (Lv. 200).'  w=' - a Transfer Hammer only reaches Lv. 140 from Lv. 130, ...'
reproducedDefect.note: On the upper rungs the empty route is worse than on the empty-slot rec, because the sentence opens with a bare em-dash where the route should be. It reads as a typographical fault rather than as missing knowledge, so nobody reports it.

contradicted.claim: LADDER lists Papulatus Mark as the middle rung of the FACE ladder AND as the first rung of the EYE ladder. One item occupies one slot, so exactly one of these is invented.
evidenceForEye: lib/sets.ts boss-accessory piece 'boss-eye' matches /black bean mark|aquatic letter eye|papulatus mark/ in the EYE slot, and 'boss-face' matches only 'condensed power crystal'. That list is transcribed from the in-game Set Effect panel on 2026-09-12.
lib/rules.ts exampleCharacter() itself equips Papulatus Mark in the eye slot and Condensed Power Crystal in the face slot. The self-test fixture disagrees with the ladder in the same file.
evidenceForFace: data/guide-graph.json node bosses.drops, row 'Chaos Papulatus' -> 'Papulatus Mark', notes 'Face accessory. Low drop rate'. That node's own source field reads 'UNVERIFIED - community drop tables.'
contradicted.howItGotThere: guide-graph node gear.slots has ONE combined row for 'Face / Eye' whose tier-1 cell reads 'Condensed Power Crystal, Papulatus Mark'. The transcription into LADDER split one row into two ladders and put both items on both. That is a fabrication introduced by the copy, not by the source.
contradicted.whyItIsWorseThanTheSecondaryBug: Papulatus Mark HAS a SOURCE row, so this rung prints a confident obtain route. A face-slot player is told 'Next tier: Papulatus Mark (Lv. 145). Chaos Papulatus - a Transfer Hammer reaches Lv. 150 from Lv. 140, so star force and potential can move onto Papulatus Mark at Lv. 145.' - a confident instruction to farm a boss and hammer an item into a slot it cannot occupy. The empty-string tell that caught the secondary is absent here.
contradicted.notSettledHere: Which slot Papulatus Mark actually occupies is NOT settled by this audit. Nexon publishes no item data. lib/farming.ts:193 shows the repo has previously settled exactly this question for the Black Bean Mark by reading api.maplestory.net's subcategory field ('Eye Decoration'). That is the check to run - one lookup, and it decides which rung to delete.

contradicted.claim: The only numeric gate anywhere in SOURCE, and the repo's own figure is not that number.
contradicted.guideGraphValue: node bosses.cp row ['Kalos / First Adversary', 'Easy+', '85-95M party', 'Weekly']
contradicted.whatWasDropped: The range (85-95M became ~85M, i.e. the bottom of the range presented as the figure) and the word PARTY. A solo player reads a party gate as their own.
contradicted.provenanceOfTheOriginal: bosses.cp source field: 'UNVERIFIED - no citable origin. The initial build credited "Games Finder boss ranges", which is undated and does not publish CP figures. Every number below Kalos is an estimate of unknown provenance.'
contradicted.firstParty: The Boss Content page gives no CP figure, no level requirement and no entry gate for any boss. It frames unlocks as quest/item prerequisites, not level or CP gates: 'There may be quests to complete or items to possess in order to unlock the boss content.'
contradicted.fix: Drop the parenthetical. 'Kalos the Guardian' is the sourced half; the CP figure is an estimate of unknown provenance shown to the player as fact.

contradicted.rung: SOURCE['Lidium Heart'] = 'Free from the Frieren Lotus mission'
contradicted.claim: The only obtain route in SOURCE that points at a time-limited collaboration event, presented as the permanent route for a gear slot.
contradicted.origin: data/guide-graph.json gear.slots, Heart row, note cell: 'Lidium Heart is free from the Frieren Lotus mission'. v.271 is 'MapleStory x Frieren: Beyond Journey's End' (data/patches.json).
contradicted.provenanceOfTheOriginal: gear.slots source field: 'UNVERIFIED - community gear progression; no citable source states this slot-by-slot ladder.'
contradicted.whyItIsAProblem: Collab events end. When it does, the heart slot's only obtain route names a mission that no longer exists, and nothing in the repo carries an expiry date for it. This is a fact with a shelf life stored as if it had none.
contradicted.fix: Either date-stamp it in the string ('v.271 Frieren event, while it runs') or retract it to the permanent route, which this repo does not have.

contradicted.rung: top rung 1 / bottom rung 1 - ['Arcane Umbra overall', 200]
contradicted.verdict: contradicted (key mismatch, not a fact error)
contradicted.claim: SOURCE holds the key 'Arcane Umbra' but the rung is spelled 'Arcane Umbra overall'. SOURCE[nm] is an exact-match lookup, so the single most travelled upgrade in the game - CRA armour into Arcane Umbra - renders with no obtain route on both the top and the bottom slot.
contradicted.rendersAs: Next tier: Arcane Umbra overall (Lv. 200).  ' - a Transfer Hammer only reaches Lv. 160 from Lv. 150, short of ...'
contradicted.fix: Add the key. The route text already exists one line above it in the same table.
contradicted.bonusFirstPartyFact: The overall/top-bottom transfer rule IS first-party and the repo does not state it: 'Overalls, as they effectively equip in both the Top and Bottom slot, can extract and transfer stats to both Top and Bottom items (as well as other Overalls).' - item-enhancement page. So a CRA top CAN hammer into an Arcane Umbra overall, which is exactly the advice this broken rung fails to give.

contradicted.rung: every laddered slot with sf:false or pot:'no' that prints a Transfer Hammer sentence
contradicted.claim: nextTierTransferNote() is emitted from the ladder branch without consulting the slot's own sf/pot flags, so it promises transfers that the slot cannot take.
observed: pocket (SLOTS: sf:false) renders 'star force and potential can move onto Stone of Eternal Life at Lv. 160'. The pocket slot takes no star force, and a Transfer Hammer requires at least 1 star to extract at all.
badge (SLOTS: pot:'no', sf:false) renders 'do not over-cube what you will replace' for a slot that takes neither cubes nor stars.
heart (SLOTS: sf:false, fl:false) renders the same.
contradicted.firstParty: 'Equipment must have at least 1 Star Force Enhancement for its abilities to be extracted.' - item-enhancement page. A slot that cannot be star forced can never be a Transfer Hammer donor.
contradicted.fix: Gate nextTierTransferNote() on slot.sf, and gate the 'do not over-cube' half on slot.pot !== 'no'.

legend.routeProvenance: sourced = a citable third-party origin exists in data/guide-graph.json with a lastVerified date; unverified = the only origin is a guide-graph node whose own source field says UNVERIFIED; none = no origin anywhere in the repo

namingProblems.what: A rung name is what the player is told to go and find. Sixteen of the 39 distinct names cannot be typed into the game's own search because they are set nicknames, categories or descriptions rather than item names.
namingProblems.note: The set names (Absolab, Arcane Umbra, Eternal, Superior Gollux) are defensible - a player does shop for 'an AbsoLab cape'. The categories and descriptions are not: 'Boss ring', 'Sweetwater face', 'Pink Bean pocket', 'Best available' and 'Any android' name nothing a player can obtain.
namingProblems.spelling: LADDER and SOURCE spell it 'Absolab'; lib/sets.ts spells it 'AbsoLab'; the game spells it AbsoLab. LADDER says 'CRA'; lib/sets.ts names the same set 'Chaos Root Abyss'. The two files disagree about the same two sets.

provenanceOfTheWholeTable.finding: LADDER is a hand-transcription of one data/guide-graph.json node, and that node declares itself unverified.
provenanceOfTheWholeTable.quote: UNVERIFIED - community gear progression; no citable source states this slot-by-slot ladder. Individual item levels are checkable on the wiki, the ordering is judgement.
provenanceOfTheWholeTable.consequence: Every rung in LADDER inherits that provenance, including the retracted secondary, which came from the same node's 'Secondary' row ('Class secondary' / 'Absolab-tier' / 'Astra secondary'). The secondary was not a uniquely bad row; it was the row somebody happened to check. Nothing downstream marks any of this as unverified - lib/rules.ts SOURCED and UNVERIFIED do not carry a LADDER entry, so the ladder prints at the same confidence as a measured number.
transcriptionLosses: gear.slots Shoulder endgame is 'Eternal (250)'; LADDER stops at Arcane Umbra.
gear.slots Weapon endgame is 'Genesis (liberated) -> Destiny'; LADDER stops at Genesis.
gear.slots Gloves tier 1 is 'CRA / Absolab (160)'; LADDER kept only Absolab.
gear.slots Belt tier 1 is 'Golden Clover / Reinforced Gollux'; LADDER kept only Reinforced Gollux.
gear.slots Earring tier 2 is 'Superior Gollux (150), Estella'; LADDER dropped Estella.
gear.slots Ring tier 3 is 'Boss rings + Special Skill Rings'; LADDER dropped Special Skill Rings.
gear.slots has ONE 'Face / Eye' row; LADDER split it into two ladders and duplicated Papulatus Mark into both. This is the only loss that INVENTED a fact rather than dropping one.

couldNotSource: Which boss drops which piece of equipment, for every rung in the table. Nexon publishes no drop table on the web and refers the player to the in-game F1 Maple Guide. This is the single fact the whole LADDER/SOURCE mechanism is built on and none of it is first-party.

The slot Papulatus Mark occupies. Two in-repo witnesses disagree and neither is first-party. api.maplestory.net's subcategory field is the check the repo has used before for exactly this question (lib/farming.ts:193) and was not run on this pass.

Any item's required level. Nexon publishes none. Every level in LADDER is community knowledge, with the single exception of Silver Blossom Ring Lv 110, corroborated only by an observation already inside this repo.
Whether an Arcane Umbra shoulder exists. lib/sets.ts assumes it does by putting 'shoulder' in a shared ARMOR_SLOTS list with AbsoLab; nothing reads it off anything.
The Genesis weapon's required level. guide-graph gear.sources gives it as '-' and LADDER states 200.
Whether the 'Boss ring' category resolves to any specific obtainable ring, and what the v.271 second Special Skill Ring slot means for a four-ring ladder.
Entry requirements, level gates and CP gates for every boss. The Boss Content page frames unlocks as quest and item prerequisites and publishes no figure for any boss.
